problem:
An inner product on $V={R}^{3}$ is given by $⟨x,y⟩=6{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+6{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{3}.$ Find $⟨x,y⟩$, if

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

feedback.problem:
An inner product on $V={R}^{3}$ is given by $⟨p,q⟩=2{p}_{1}{q}_{1}+2{p}_{2}{q}_{2}+3{p}_{3}{q}_{3}.$ Find $⟨p,q⟩$, if

$$
p=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3 \\ -4\end{aligned}],\,q=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Computing the inner product according to the definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨p,q⟩ & =2{p}_{1}{q}_{1}+2{p}_{2}{q}_{2}+3{p}_{3}{q}_{3} \\  & =2\cdot 1\cdot 5+2\cdot (-3)\cdot 2+3\cdot (-4)\cdot 2 \\  & =10-12-24 \\  & =-26.\end{aligned}
$$
